headline: US Lawmakers Move to Block China's DUV Lithography Access, Escalating Tech War and Threatening Chipmaking Lifeline
summary: Proposed US legislation like the MATCH Act aims to severely restrict China's access to DUV lithography tools, directly impacting its ability to produce a wide range of semiconductors. This regulatory shift marks a significant escalation in the US-China tech rivalry, threatening global semiconductor supply chains and China's AI infrastructure development.
